neighbours.label: the word that starts a description right after a product noun ('earbuds that …', 'the tea you buy …', 'this lotion is …')
fire: These are earbuds that charge in under an hour.
This moisturizer is also enriched with aloe.
The tea you buy from our shop is grown in Nepal.
Here are backpacks that survive heavy rain.
This blender is also easy to clean.
The candles you light tonight will smell of pine.
Look for running shoes that support your arches.
This shampoo is gentle enough for daily use.

notes: top: ' that' x10, ' is' x6 after product nouns (sanitizer is, hearing aids that, the kratom you). Probes: 'headphones that' 0.64, 'Yesterday it is' 0.
